graph_nodes_kind_ck.name: graph_nodes_kind_ck
graph_nodes_kind_ck.value:
case "graph_nodes"."kind"
        when 'person' then "graph_nodes"."person_id" is not null
        when 'company' then "graph_nodes"."company_id" is not null
        when 'counterparty' then "graph_nodes"."counterparty_id" is not null
        when 'policy_sector' then "graph_nodes"."sector_key" is not null
        when 'policy_event' then "graph_nodes"."policy_event_id" is not null
        when 'party' then "graph_nodes"."party_name" is not null
      end

influence_edges_valid_ck.name: influence_edges_valid_ck
influence_edges_valid_ck.value: "influence_edges"."valid_to" is null or "influence_edges"."valid_from" is null or "influence_edges"."valid_from" <= "influence_edges"."valid_to"

person_roles_dates_ck.name: person_roles_dates_ck
person_roles_dates_ck.value: "person_roles"."to_date" is null or "person_roles"."from_date" is null or "person_roles"."from_date" <= "person_roles"."to_date"

relationship_estimates_order_ck.name: relationship_estimates_order_ck
relationship_estimates_order_ck.value:
("relationship_estimates"."value_low_cr" is null or "relationship_estimates"."value_cr" is null or "relationship_estimates"."value_low_cr" <= "relationship_estimates"."value_cr")
        and ("relationship_estimates"."value_high_cr" is null or "relationship_estimates"."value_cr" is null or "relationship_estimates"."value_cr" <= "relationship_estimates"."value_high_cr")
